issues.resolution: Preserve the published range as descriptive metadata. Enforce named groups and the 27-credit elective minimum rather than inventing a total.

issues.issue: Only named core courses and selected cross-major senior electives are encoded. Capstones depend on offerings.
issues.resolution: An unlisted elective is unknown, not automatically ineligible. Verify capstone approval and expand the senior list when needed.

issues.issue: Course eligibility in two majors does not establish permission to double-count credits.
issues.resolution: Calculate tentative matches separately and flag allocation for advisor review. AMATH and ACMS are different programs.

issues.issue: Existing CSE/AMATH schedule covers 20 selected courses. INFO addition is a course inventory, not a parsed section-meeting dataset.
issues.resolution: Use sections.json only for existing section data. INFO inventory alone cannot prove schedule conflicts or registration eligibility.

issues.issue: Current AMATH and INFO pages do not provide a precise effective year. CS checklist revision is September 2023.
issues.resolution: Match the student requirement profile before declaring degree progress.
